name: like_storm
title: Like storm: edge writes
expect: Split adjacency (Condensed/Split): 2 small keys per like
why: a like appends to two lists (the person's likes, the post's likers). Split writes two new small keys ({sp_like} and 2 PUTs per like); Condensed reads both whole lists and rewrites them ({cc_like} written and {cc_like_ops} ops per like), Chunked their chunks ({ch_like}). So Split wins the writes in bytes and in ops. The few friend-list reads go the other way ({cc_knows} ops Condensed against {sp_knows} Split). A mixed layout takes both: likes Split, knows Condensed.

why_scale_free.2: one new record per list: likes is declared in both directions (schema)
